verdict.rationale: Tailscale's WireGuard-based mesh gives devices stable virtual IPs that in principle allow SSH sessions to survive network roaming, and users report seamless SSH access to boxes (tailscale-docs-7, tailscale-docs-6). However, community evidence shows real-world friction with network transitions (mobile carrier breaking connectivity, DERP fallback limiting speed, guest wifi blocking control ports), which undermines a truly seamless 'session stays alive across sleep/network change' experience without extra fallback (e.g., mosh/tmux).
